gaps.explanation: Statement pp6-7 Total Governmental Funds revenue lines add to 17,117,827 (printed Total revenues 17,117,826); fund columns General 8,143,482 + Streets 3,757,848 + Economic Development 1,970,588 + Debt Service 303,447 + Special Projects 371,175 + Capital Projects 1,027,038 + Other Governmental Funds 1,544,245 = 17,117,823. detail[] 20,375,649 = budget-basis schedules pp14-19 (General 11,403,191, Streets 3,681,695, Economic Development 1,917,194, Debt Service 284,840, Special Projects 499,641, Capital Projects lines 1,031,480 + 13,363 = 1,044,843, printed total 1,044,842) + nonmajor combining pp20-21 1,544,245 (= Other Governmental Funds column). Every fund column is in detail[]; budget basis vs GAAP per fund: General +3,259,709, Streets -76,153, Economic Development -53,394, Debt Service -18,607, Special Projects +128,466, Capital Projects +17,805 = +3,257,826; less the 4 by which the JSON Total-column lines exceed the fund columns = 3,257,822 = the gap. The budget-basis rows (Taxes / Intergovernmental / Local) are not itemized further, so nothing can be removed or split. No fix.

Statement pp6-7 expenditure lines in the Total column add to 19,102,068 (printed Total expenditures 19,102,067 = General 10,704,083 + Streets 3,279,980 + Economic Development 2,142,625 + Debt Service 499,126 + Special Projects 304,180 + Capital Projects 132,669 + Other Governmental Funds 2,039,404). detail[] 19,068,902 = budget-basis pp14-19 (General 10,710,876, Streets 3,548,620, Economic Development 2,143,918, Debt Service 245,748, Special Projects 247,667, Capital Projects 132,669) + nonmajor combining pp20-21 2,039,404. Budget basis vs GAAP: General +6,793, Streets +268,640, Economic Development +1,293, Debt Service -253,378, Special Projects -56,513 = -33,165; plus the 1 by which the Total-column lines exceed the printed total = 33,166 = the gap. No missing or duplicate lines. No fix.

pp6-7 governmental funds statement, Other financing sources: 'Proceeds from sale of assets' General Fund column 31,407 (p6) and 'Insurance proceeds' Special Projects Fund column 156,814 (p7; the Total column prints 156,812, a 2 rounding difference in the report). 'Capital Contribution' is '-' in every column. detail[] has only the two transfer lines (General Transfers In 3,396,423, Streets Transfers Out (12,500)); the budget-basis schedules pp14-19 print no other-financing section. Neither row is added, because the money may already be inside the budget-basis 'Local' lines in detail: General Fund p14 'Local' 4,436,959 is far above the p6 GAAP local rows (151,412 + 427,658 + 247,573 + 193,791 = 1,020,434), close to the General Fund's total other financing (transfers in 3,396,423 + sale 31,407); Special Projects p18 'Local' 322,356 is above the GAAP investment 82,237 + other 123,108 = 205,345 by 117,011, and the p18 budget excess 251,974 is close to the GAAP change including the insurance proceeds (223,809), not to the GAAP excess of revenues 66,995. The page does not show whether 31,407 or 156,814 is inside 'Local', so adding them could count the money twice. Remaining: detail 0 vs JSON other_financing 188,219 (Total column 156,812 + 31,407) - a budget-basis vs GAAP difference (budget 'Local' lines in detail vs GAAP other-financing rows on pp6-7); no fix.

No business-type lines in detail[] and no proprietary schedule in the report. pp10-11 Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds, Business-type Activities enterprise columns (rows in receipts[]: Charges for services, Other revenues, Investment income): Environmental Services 3,226,779 + 269 + 91,571 = 3,318,619; Wastewater 2,785,468 + 12,362 + 79,914 = 2,877,744; Water 2,212,532 + 86,168 + 134,296 = 2,432,996; Electric 3,365,829 + 46,504 = 3,412,333; Stormwater 146,834 + 8,258 + 24,741 = 179,833. Sum 12,221,525 (added). JSON business-type receipts 12,224,524 = Totals column (11,737,442 + 107,057 + 380,025), which includes the Business-type 'Internal Service' column (p11 Investment income 2,998). Residual 2,999 = Internal Service 2,998 + 1 (the columns add to 380,024; Totals prints 380,025). Internal service funds are never added; that printed amount is the only remaining difference.
